# noderings_virtual_machines (Data Source)

Lists the organization's virtual machines, sorted by hostname.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_virtual_machines" "web" {
  tags           = ["web"]
  power_state    = "running"
  hostname_regex = "^web-"
}

output "web_ips" {
  value = data.noderings_virtual_machines.web.virtual_machines[*].ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname_regex` (String) Only VMs whose hostname matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax).
- `power_state` (String) Only VMs in this state: `running` or `stopped`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Only VMs that have all of these tags.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_machines` (Attributes List) Matching VMs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_machines))

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_machines`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `distro` (String) Operating system.
- `firewall_ruleset_id` (String) Attached firewall ruleset.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname.
- `id` (String) VM ID.
- `ipv4` (String) Primary IPv4 address.
- `ipv6` (String) Primary IPv6 address.
- `plan_code` (String) Plan code.
- `plan_id` (String) Plan ID.
- `power_state` (String) `running` or `stopped`, empty while transitioning.
- `provider_name` (String) Hosting provider.
- `provisioning_state` (String) Provisioning state.
- `region_city` (String) City.
- `region_country` (String) Country.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags.
